Name: (CP) Craftable Wood Chipper
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
In yet another installment of 'Lily-Makes-An-Uncraftable-Item-Craftable' we have the Wood Chipper! 

Now you can get a recipe for it in a vanilla friendly way... if you use it at all that is. I forget they exist sometimes - unless I need them, and then I never have any. 

[b][u]Unlock Conditions:[/u][/b] 
[spoiler]- 9 Hearts with Robin
- Already read the mail that is sent on Winter 2nd about the Wood Chipper

After you meet these conditions, Robin will send you a letter in the mail that unlocks the recipe[/spoiler]

[b][u]Recipe:[/u][/b]
- 10 Hardwood
- 4 Iron Bars
- 45 Stone
- 1 Battery Pack

[b]Note: [/b][i]I included translation files for the letter - if you want to translate it just provide the pastebin for it and I can add it to the mod :)[/i]

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b] 

[i]Thank you to Jessie and EnderTedi in the Krobus server for the help! [/i]
